  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devicons/devicon@latest/devicon.min.css" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #09090f;
      --bg2: #111118;
      --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .07);
      --text: #e2e8f0;
      --muted: #6b7280;
      --accent: #22c55e;
      --accent2: #16a34a;
      --nav-bg: rgba(9, 9, 15, .72);
      --card-bg: rgba(16, 16, 22, .98);
      --top-nav-h: 60px;
    }

    html.light {
      --bg: #f4f4f8;
      --bg2: #fff;
      --border: rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
      --text: #111;
      --muted: #6b7280;
      --nav-bg: rgba(244, 244, 248, .82);
      --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, .98);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      cursor: none;
      transition: background .4s, color .4s;
    }

    ::selection {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #000;
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 5px;
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--accent2);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    /* CURSOR */
    #c-dot {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 99999;
      pointer-events: none;
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      transition: width .1s, height .1s;
    }

    #c-ring {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 99998;
      pointer-events: none;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, .5);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      transition: width .2s, height .2s, border-color .2s;
    }

    .c-tr {
      position: fixed;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 99997;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background: var(--accent);
      opacity: .4;
      animation: trFade .55s ease forwards;
    }

    @keyframes trFade {
      to {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
      }
    }

    /* ═══ TOP NAV — n8n style full-width floating bar ═══ */
    #top-nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 12px;
      left: 50%;
      z-index: 700;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 12px 0 20px;
      height: 54px;
      width: min(960px, 96vw);
      background: rgba(12, 12, 18, .75);
      backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(200%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(200%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .06) inset;
      transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.2, .64, 1), opacity .4s;
    }

    #top-nav.hidden {
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-130%);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    html.light #top-nav {
      background: rgba(248, 248, 252, .8);
      border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .1);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08), 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1);
    }

    /* logo */
    .tn-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      text-decoration: none;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tn-logo-icon {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f7a35, #22c55e);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -.5px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(34, 197, 94, .35);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tn-logo-icon::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .15), transparent);
    }

    .tn-logo-txt {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text);
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
    }

    .tn-logo-txt span {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .tn-logo-badge {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, .12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, .25);
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-left: 4px;
    }

    /* center links */
    .tn-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1px;
    }

    .tn-link {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      padding: 7px 14px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: none;
      transition: color .18s, background .18s;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .tn-link i {
      font-size: 11px;
      opacity: .7;
    }

    .tn-link:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    }

    html.light .tn-link:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
    }

    .tn-link.on {
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
    }

    .tn-link.on i {
      color: var(--accent);
      opacity: 1;
    }

    html.light .tn-link.on {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .07);
    }

    /* right */
    .tn-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tn-ico {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: none;
      border: none;
      background: none;
      transition: color .18s, background .18s;
    }

    .tn-ico:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .09);
    }

    html.light .tn-ico:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .07);
    }

    .tn-sep {
      width: 1px;
      height: 18px;
      background: var(--border);
      margin: 0 4px;
    }

    .tn-cta {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #16a34a, #22c55e);
      color: #000;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: none;
      transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s, box-shadow .2s;
      border: none;
      font-family: inherit;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(34, 197, 94, .3);
    }

    .tn-cta:hover {
      opacity: .9;
      transform: scale(1.03);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(34, 197, 94, .5);
    }

    /* ═══ BOTTOM PILL NAV — with label pop ═══ */
    #bot-nav {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: 50%;
      z-index: 700;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
      opacity: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 18, .88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(200%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(200%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .13);
      border-radius: 100px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .07) inset;
      transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.2, .64, 1), opacity .4s;
    }

    #bot-nav.show {
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
      opacity: 1;
    }

    html.light #bot-nav {
      background: rgba(234, 234, 240, .95);
      border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .1);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15);
    }

    .bn-item {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #9ca3af;
      font-size: 16px;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: none;
      border: none;
      background: none;
      transition: color .2s, background .2s, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1);
      position: relative;
    }

    .bn-item:hover {
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .13);
      transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.15);
    }

    html.light .bn-item:hover {
      color: #111;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
    }

    .bn-item.on {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .bn-item.on::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 2px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 4px;
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    /* tooltip label */
    .bn-item::before {
      content: attr(data-tip);
      position: absolute;
      bottom: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
      background: rgba(12, 12, 20, .97);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 11px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity .18s, transform .2s;
      letter-spacing: .02em;
    }

    .bn-item:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }

    .bn-sep {
      width: 1px;
      height: 22px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
      margin: 0 4px;
      border-radius: 1px;
    }

    html.light .bn-sep {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .1);
    }

    /* SCROLL TOP */
    #scr-top {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 90px;
      right: 18px;
      z-index: 500;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--accent);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(8px);
      transition: opacity .3s, transform .3s, background .2s;
    }

    #scr-top.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    #scr-top:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #000;
    }

    /* PAGES */
    .pg {
      display: none;
    }

    .pg.on {
      display: block;
    }

    /* GLASS */
    .glass {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: background .4s, border-color .4s;
    }

    /* PROJECT CARDS */
    .pcard {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: none;
      transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.2, .64, 1), border-color .35s, box-shadow .35s;
    }

    .pcard:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, .22);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 44px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
    }

    .pcard-iw {
      margin: 8px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      height: 178px;
      background: #1a1a22;
    }

    .pcard-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform .55s ease;
    }

    .pcard:hover .pcard-img {
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .pfull {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: none;
      transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.2, .64, 1), border-color .35s, box-shadow .35s;
    }

    .pfull:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, .2);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
    }

    .pfull>div:first-child img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      transition: transform .55s ease;
    }

    .pfull:hover>div:first-child img {
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }

    /* TAG */
    .tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: background .2s, color .2s;
    }

    html.light .tag {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
    }

    .tag:hover {
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, .1);
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* ═══ SKILLS — fade edges ═══ */
    .skills-wrap {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .skills-wrap::before,
    .skills-wrap::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 160px;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .skills-wrap::before {
      left: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--bg) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }

    .skills-wrap::after {
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to left, var(--bg) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }

    html.light .skills-wrap::before {
      background: linear-gradient(to right, #f4f4f8 0%, transparent 100%);
    }

    html.light .skills-wrap::after {
      background: linear-gradient(to left, #f4f4f8 0%, transparent 100%);
    }

    .s-row {
      display: flex;
      overflow: hidden;
      mask-image: none;
      -webkit-mask-image: none;
    }

    .s-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 6px 0;
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .s-track.sl {
      animation: sl 45s linear infinite;
    }

    .s-track.sr {
      animation: sr 45s linear infinite;
    }

    .s-row:hover .s-track {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    @keyframes sl {
      0% {
        transform: translateX(0);
      }

      100% {
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }
    }

    @keyframes sr {
      0% {
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }

      100% {
        transform: translateX(0);
      }
    }

    .sbox {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 84px;
      height: 84px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 18px;
      cursor: none;
      transition: all .3s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .sbox::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--sb-color, rgba(34, 197, 94, .12));
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .3s;
    }

    .sbox:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .sbox:hover {
      border-color: var(--sb-border, rgba(34, 197, 94, .4));
      transform: translateY(-7px) scale(1.07);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
    }

    .sbox i {
      font-size: 28px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .sbox span {
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      text-align: center;
      transition: color .2s;
    }

    .sbox:hover span {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    /* GRADIENT TEXT */
    .tg {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #16a34a 0%, #22c55e 55%, #4ade80 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    /* HERO */
    .p-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34, 197, 94, .45) 0%, transparent 70%);
      filter: blur(38px);
      z-index: -1;
      animation: gp 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes gp {

      0%,
      100% {
        opacity: .3;
        transform: scale(.93);
      }

      50% {
        opacity: .8;
        transform: scale(1.07);
      }
    }

    .float {
      animation: fy 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes fy {

      0%,
      100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
      }

      50% {
        transform: translateY(-10px);
      }
    }

    .rcursor {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 2px;
      height: 1em;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 2px;
      margin-left: 3px;
      vertical-align: middle;
      animation: blink 1.1s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes blink {

      0%,
      100% {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      50% {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }

    #hero-cv {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      pointer-events: none;
      animation: bl 18s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes bl {
      0% {
        transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
      }

      33% {
        transform: translate(40px, -50px) scale(1.07);
      }

      66% {
        transform: translate(-30px, 20px) scale(.95);
      }

      100% {
        transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
      }
    }

    /* SPOTIFY */
    #sp-widget {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 22px;
      left: 18px;
      z-index: 500;
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 12px;
      width: 264px;
    }

    /* MODAL */
    #modal {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      display: none;
    }

    #mb {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .3s;
    }

    #mbox {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 16px;
    }

    #mi {
      background: #0c0c14;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 840px;
      max-height: 90vh;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transform: scale(.88);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.2, .64, 1), opacity .35s;
    }

    @media(min-width:600px) {
      #mi {
        flex-direction: row;
      }
    }

    .mi-img {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 220px;
      background: #060610;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

            <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;">${(p.tg || []).slice(0, 3).map(t => `<span class="tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>
          </div>
        </div>`).join('');
    }

    let mImgs = [], mIdx = 0;
    function openM(i) {
      const p = PJ[i];
      document.getElementById('m-sub').textContent = p.s;
      document.getElementById('m-title').textContent = p.t;
      document.getElementById('m-desc').textContent = p.d;
      document.getElementById('m-tags').innerHTML = (p.tg || []).map(t => `<span class="tag"><i class="${ico(t)}" style="color:var(--accent);font-size:10px;"></i>${t}</span>`).join('');
      const md = document.getElementById('m-demo'), mc = document.getElementById('m-code');
      mc.href = p.gh || '#';
      if (p.dm && p.dm.trim()) { md.href = p.dm; md.style.display = ''; } else md.style.display = 'none';
      mImgs = (p.im && p.im.length) ? p.im : [p.cv]; mIdx = 0; updMImg();
      const prev = document.getElementById('m-prev'), next = document.getElementById('m-next'), dots = document.getElementById('m-dots');
      if (mImgs.length > 1) { prev.style.display = 'flex'; next.style.display = 'flex'; dots.style.display = 'flex'; rendDots(); }
      else { prev.style.display = 'none'; next.style.display = 'none'; dots.style.display = 'none'; }
      const mo = document.getElementById('modal'), mb2 = document.getElementById('mb'), mi2 = document.getElementById('mi');
      mo.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => { mb2.style.opacity = '1'; mi2.style.transform = 'scale(1)'; mi2.style.opacity = '1'; }, 10);
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeModal() {
      const mb2 = document.getElementById('mb'), mi2 = document.getElementById('mi');
      mb2.style.opacity = '0'; mi2.style.transform = 'scale(.9)'; mi2.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('modal').style.display = 'none'; document.body.style.overflow = ''; }, 270);
    }
    function shiftImg(d) { mIdx = (mIdx + d + mImgs.length) % mImgs.length; updMImg(); }
    function updMImg() { document.getElementById('m-img').src = mImgs[mIdx]; updDots(); }
    function rendDots() {
      const d = document.getElementById('m-dots'); if (!d) return;
      d.style.display = 'flex';
      d.innerHTML = mImgs.map((_, i) => `<button style="width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:none;background:${i === mIdx ? 'var(--accent)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)'};transition:background .2s;" onclick="mIdx=${i};updMImg();"></button>`).join('');
    }
    function updDots() {
      const d = document.getElementById('m-dots'); if (!d) return;
      [...d.children].forEach((b, i) => b.style.background = i === mIdx ? 'var(--accent)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)');
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal(); });

    function sp(p) {
      ['home', 'projects', 'about'].forEach(n => {
        const pg = document.getElementById('pg-' + n); if (pg) pg.classList.remove('on');
        const tn = document.getElementById('tn-' + n), bn = document.getElementById('bn-' + n);
        if (tn) tn.classList.remove('on'); if (bn) bn.classList.remove('on');
      });
      document.getElementById('pg-' + p).classList.add('on');
      const tn = document.getElementById('tn-' + p), bn = document.getElementById('bn-' + p);
      if (tn) tn.classList.add('on'); if (bn) bn.classList.add('on');
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      setTimeout(obsAOS, 100);
    }

    let dark = true;
    function toggleTheme() {
      dark = !dark;
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('light', !dark);
      const ic = dark ? 'fa-sun' : 'fa-moon';
      ['th-icon', 'bth-icon'].forEach(id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.className = 'fas ' + ic; });
    }

    const cdot = document.getElementById('c-dot'), cring = document.getElementById('c-ring');
    let rx = 0, ry = 0, mx_ = 0, my_ = 0, lastTr = 0;
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      mx_ = e.clientX; my_ = e.clientY;
      cdot.style.left = mx_ + 'px'; cdot.style.top = my_ + 'px';
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastTr > 40 && Math.random() > .55) {
        const tr = document.createElement('div'); tr.className = 'c-tr';
        const sz = (1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5) + 'px';
        tr.style.cssText = `left:${mx_}px;top:${my_}px;width:${sz};height:${sz};`;
        document.body.appendChild(tr); setTimeout(() => tr.remove(), 550); lastTr = now;
      }
      const hov = e.target.closest('a,button,[onclick],.pcard,.pfull,.sbox');
      cdot.style.width = hov ? '14px' : '7px'; cdot.style.height = hov ? '14px' : '7px';
      cring.style.width = hov ? '40px' : '26px'; cring.style.height = hov ? '40px' : '26px';
      cring.style.borderColor = hov ? 'rgba(34,197,94,.85)' : 'rgba(34,197,94,.5)';
    });
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { cdot.style.transform = 'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.55)'; });
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { cdot.style.transform = 'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)'; });
    (function animR() { rx += (mx_ - rx) * .12; ry += (my_ - ry) * .12; cring.style.left = rx + 'px'; cring.style.top = ry + 'px'; requestAnimationFrame(animR); })();

    function likeAt(e) {
      const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'like-pop';
      el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-heart" style="color:var(--accent);"></i>';
      el.style.left = e.clientX + 'px'; el.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
      document.body.appendChild(el); setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 460);
    }

    const topNav = document.getElementById('top-nav');
    const botNav = document.getElementById('bot-nav');
    const scrTop = document.getElementById('scr-top');
    let ticking = false;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (!ticking) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const y = window.scrollY;
          if (y > 80) { topNav.classList.add('hidden'); botNav.classList.add('show'); scrTop.classList.add('show'); }
          else { topNav.classList.remove('hidden'); botNav.classList.remove('show'); scrTop.classList.remove('show'); }
          ticking = false;
        });
        ticking = true;
      }
    });

    const cv2 = document.getElementById('hero-cv');
    if (cv2) {
      const ctx2 = cv2.getContext('2d'); let pts2 = [];
      function rsz2() { cv2.width = window.innerWidth; cv2.height = window.innerHeight; }
      window.addEventListener('resize', rsz2); rsz2();
      for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) pts2.push({ x: Math.random() * cv2.width, y: Math.random() * cv2.height, vx: (Math.random() - .5) * .4, vy: (Math.random() - .5) * .4, r: Math.random() * 1.3 + .4 });
      function fr2() {
        ctx2.clearRect(0, 0, cv2.width, cv2.height);
        pts2.forEach(p => {
          p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
          if (p.x < 0 || p.x > cv2.width) p.vx *= -1;
          if (p.y < 0 || p.y > cv2.height) p.vy *= -1;
          ctx2.fillStyle = 'rgba(34,197,94,.25)';
          ctx2.beginPath(); ctx2.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx2.fill();
        });
        for (let a = 0; a < pts2.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < pts2.length; b++) {
          const dx = pts2[a].x - pts2[b].x, dy = pts2[a].y - pts2[b].y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d < 80) { ctx2.strokeStyle = `rgba(34,197,94,${.13 * (1 - d / 80)})`; ctx2.lineWidth = .25; ctx2.beginPath(); ctx2.moveTo(pts2[a].x, pts2[a].y); ctx2.lineTo(pts2[b].x, pts2[b].y); ctx2.stroke(); }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(fr2);
      }
      fr2();
    }

    const roleEl = document.getElementById('role-txt');
    const roles = ['Software Engineer', 'Fullstack Developer', 'AI/ML Enthusiast', 'Backend Developer'];
    let ri = 0, rc = 0, rd = false;
    function type() {
      if (!roleEl) return;
      const cur = roles[ri];
      if (rd) { roleEl.textContent = cur.substring(0, rc - 1); rc--; }
      else { roleEl.textContent = cur.substring(0, rc + 1); rc++; }
      let spd = rd ? 40 : 75;
      if (!rd && rc === cur.length) { spd = 2200; rd = true; }
      else if (rd && rc === 0) { rd = false; ri = (ri + 1) % roles.length; spd = 400; }
      setTimeout(type, spd);
    }
    setTimeout(type, 700);

    function toggleSpotify() {
      const w = document.getElementById('sp-wrap'), b = document.getElementById('sp-btn');
      w.style.display = w.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
      b.textContent = w.style.display === 'none' ? 'Buka' : 'Tutup';
    }

    function obsAOS() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-aos]').forEach(el => {
        if (!el.classList.contains('aon')) {
          const ob = new IntersectionObserver(ens => { ens.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { el.classList.add('aon'); ob.disconnect(); } }); }, { threshold: .1 });
          ob.observe(el);
        }
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { renderSkills(); renderFeat(); renderAll(); obsAOS(); });
  </script>
